findings.fact: Initial live series treated an unknown child age as explicit user_pause; next answer stayed queued.
findings.action: Distinguish missing data from explicit pause; preserve stop priority on invalid patch/conflicts.
findings.closure: Relevant real-model clarification/answer turn passes after current fixes; blocked upstream does not close this.

findings.fact: Initial live reminder of breakfast generated an invalid domain operation and recoverable error.
findings.action: Domain preflight with safe schema feedback and bounded same-model repair; no fabricated values.
findings.closure: Relevant actual turn passes after fix and state/constraints preserved.

findings.fact: Unknown city was rejected as processing error instead of controlled clarification.
findings.action: Validate supported city before applying batch, return one question without mutation.
findings.closure: Actual unknown request completes with controlled question, no search/order.

findings.fact: update_traveler age removed and appended a group member, changing canonical group order.
findings.action: Only rewrite group membership when group_id actually changes.
findings.closure: Age-update regression and relevant actual dialogue preserve groups and member order.

findings.fact: Alternate live Xing turn preserved dates but returned wrong budget magnitude for Russian number words.
findings.action: Ground unambiguous scalar/relative RUB budget operations in deterministic Decimal/int parsing; keep original failed report.
findings.closure: Table edge cases and targeted actual mass-edit rerun pass without modifying frozen fixture.

findings.fact: Patch rejection/semantic conflict could lose explicit wait/cancel.
findings.action: Preserve execution control separately from rejected operations.
findings.closure: Nine controlled API/PG regressions passed; no claim of all natural language forms.

findings.fact: Cross-worker pause stopped late writes via CAS but could allow subsequent provider calls.
findings.action: Read-check current version, active run/status and pause before each model/tool dispatch; no long transaction.
findings.limits: A request already dispatched cannot be recalled atomically with a DB commit.

findings.fact: Actual localhost DB connection refusal before intake returned HTTP500.
findings.action: Handle raw connection/timeout errors as safe retryable503; no intake on failure.
findings.limits: Global database crash is a separate unqualified boundary.

findings.fact: NVIDIA free endpoint five-minute/30-minute instability and5xx; Gemma/Xing shared-pool429. Dots returned responses via another upstream.
findings.action: Free-only routing, circuit cooldown, stop acceptance suite on provider outage, no paid fallback.
findings.closure: Bounded actual turn passes on selected profile; no guarantee of future free-service uptime.

findings.fact: Owner confirmed E SSD disconnect/reconnect; Windows readable while WSL drvfs returnedErrno19.
findings.action: Mounted verified E drvfs over stale/busy mount only in AegML-Hackathon, matched SHA and re-synced source. No forced umount/shutdown/AEGYX changes.
findings.evidence: 304 tests passed after access restoration; extra alias and old mount remain busy.
findings.closure: Current access recovered; permanent hardware cause and safe stale mount cleanup remain outside code verification.
